hooks.text: Three Earths at the same time.
Jupiter's giant red storm once swallowed three Earths.
Jupiter's storm is shrinking, but still swallows Earth.

title: The Storm That Swallows Earth
description: Jupiter's Great Red Spot has been shrinking for a century, yet this 250-kilometer-deep vortex remains large enough to engulf our entire world.
